_comment: TEMPLATE (not a prototype): app store top chart rank (needs keeper snapshot at T)
claim: App id 6462904878 is ranked in the top 10 of the US App Store Top Free iPhone chart at the keeper snapshot taken nearest 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show app id 6462904878 within the first 10 entries of the US Top Free apps chart in the snapshot taken within 30 minutes of 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z?

custom_definitions: The chart is live-only: no history endpoint exists, so only a keeper snapshot captured within 30 minutes of the instant can prove rank at that instant; a later fetch proves nothing.
Rank is the position in the chart's results array (1-based); region us; chart top-free; device iPhone.
Ranking can be gamed by short bursts of installs; v2 only.
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.
